objective: Preallocate VectorIndex top-level index maps for the default index slot.

tasks.title: Preallocate vector index map
tasks.result: VectorIndex now creates its top-level index map with capacity for the default index slot created during Fusion storage initialization.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The top-level VectorIndex map capacity is 1 because Fusion storage initialization creates the default vector index immediately after VectorIndex::new().
The optimization only changes initial HashMap allocation for index wrappers; lazy wrapper creation, vector insertion, HNSW rebuild, delete, and search semantics are unchanged.
